“Trump Fuel” Station Turns Heads With Eye-Popping Prices A new gas station covered from one end to the other in Trump-themed signs and patriotic decorations held its grand opening in Branson this week, and the unusual business is already getting plenty of attention. The station, called Trump Fuel, features large Trump displays, American flags, “America First” messaging and Trump 2028 signs throughout the property. The theme extends from the roadside sign and fuel pumps to the canopy and convenience store. But the prices posted along the highway are attracting just as much attention as the decorations. Regular is listed at $18.99 a gallon, plus at $19.49 and premium at $19.99. Diesel is the most expensive option at $21.49 a gallon. Several vehicles could be seen at the pumps during the grand opening as drivers stopped to see the new station for themselves. The combination of extremely high fuel prices and extensive political branding has also made the location difficult to miss for motorists passing through the area. Trump Fuel is now open to customers in Branson, with the convenience store and fuel pumps operating following this week’s grand-opening celebration.
